name: mr-rob0to
description: Plugins for coding agents, grouped by purpose: skills, hooks and Claude Code mods. Skills are self-contained folders that work in Claude Code, Codex, and any harness that reads SKILL.md folders.

plugins.name: qed
plugins.description: Software delivery. ship takes a finished branch through a guarded pre-merge gate: right base, bound commits, independent reviews, a filled pull request, and a CI watch.

plugins.name: worktree-setup
plugins.description: Worktree sessions. At session start, tells the agent whether it is in a linked worktree and runs the repo's make worktree-setup target when the repo declares one.

plugins.name: release-radar
plugins.description: Release status. A Claude Code pane, opened with /releases, that shows what is coming in the next release and what shipped in past releases of any GitHub repo.
